protocol.bootstrap_unit: paired graph; resample all arms together; rerank exact half within draw
protocol.multiplicity: Bonferroni five one-sided percentile bounds; simultaneous family alpha0.05
protocol.scope: anonymous graph adaptation; not KG-Guard reproduction or energy superiority
protocol.seed_reduction: mean probabilities within arm; seeds are not examples
protocol.source_population: V765 n uniform50..60; independent undirected edges p=3/(n-1); uniform source; nonempty equal k2/k3 cardinality
protocol.temperature_selection: one per arm; minimize ensemble Brier on fresh calibration only; ascending ties
